posts.title: Ocupar as redes que sonhamos e merecemos
posts.description: Para que lentamente possamos construir as redes que sonhamos e merecemos, que nos permitam encontrar online para organizar offline, e assim reduzir a nossa dependência das plataformas Big Tech.

posts.title: AI is the last of capitalism’s distraction
posts.description: It's not AI that will destroy mankind, it's capitalism's insatiable greed. It's the billionaire class that always wants more.

posts.title: Democracy Now! is also a video podcast
posts.description: Democracy Now! has a video podcast, and has had one for the last 15 years, at least. This means you can experience the show in either audio or video.
